# HUANGSI

> Foshan Huangsi Furniture Co., Ltd. is a commercial office furniture manufacturer and project supplier based in Foshan, Guangdong, China.

- [Packaging and loading](https://huangsifurniture.com/packaging-loading): Export packing and container planning.
- [Contact and RFQ](https://huangsifurniture.com/contact): Quotation requirements and verified contact details.
